paper_title: Shining Light on the Dark Sector: Search for Axion-like Particles and Other New Physics in Photonic Final States with FASER
notes: FASER search for ALPs decaying to two photons. Primary target is ALP-W (g_aWW coupling to W bosons, GeV^-1), with reinterpretations for ALP-photon (g_agamma), ALP-gluon, U(1)_B vector boson, up-philic scalar, and 2HDM. While the paper does constrain g_agamma (AxionPhoton) for the ALP-photon model, no numerical limit data points are present in the provided text — exclusion contours are only described as figures. The primary coupling is actually g_aWW (W boson coupling), not directly in the enum. No extractable (mass, coupling) pairs available from text or tables. | Vision: ALP-W model with coupling g_aWW labeled as 'ALP Coupling g_a [1/GeV]'. Traced the lower edge of the observed limit (blue) closed contour. The exclusion is the region enclosed by the contour; lower boundary traced here. Mass converted from MeV to eV.
